text: CFPB : My mortgage is serviced by AmeriHome Mortgage Company LLC. My taxes and insurance are paid by AmeriHome through an escrow account. AmeriHome has not paid my City of XXXX ( Kentucky ) taxes, which were due on XX/XX/XXXX. I have called numerous times and each time they tell me that they will pay it. To date, it has still not been paid. I have checked with the City on this and they have not recieved anything from Amerihome. My last phone conversation with AmeriHome was today and it made me me realize that they have not been proactive on this issue at all. The last payment they attempted to the City was rejected. To my knowledge, they did nothing to investigate why the check was not accepted and never contacted me to let me know. Had I not received ( yet another ) delinquent tax notice from the City, I might have let this go on even longer without realizing my taxes have not been paid. It is incredibly frustrating to rely on such an incompetent company to pay my taxes. I spent an hour on the phone this morning with them, which is an hour I have to take away from my own workday. Additionally, they are transferring my mortgage to a new company, XXXX XXXX, and I got the feeling that they do not care about my tax issue since I will no longer be their account come XX/XX/XXXX. Lastly, I did tell them that I'm filing this Complaint.
